Brown Tumor of Hyperparathyroidism: Medical history: primary hyperparathyroidism 6 years prior to presentation
Laboratory test result: Hypercalcemia at 3.6 mmol/L (reference range 2.05-2.55 mmol/L)
Laboratory test result: Hypophosphatemia at 0.65 mmol/L (reference range 0.87-1.45 mmol/L)
Laboratory test result: Elevated serum parathyroid hormone at 380 pmol/L (reference range 1.6-6.9 pmol/L)
Clinical examination finding: large tumor on the distal part of the right fourth finger
Pathology finding: Histopathology of finger tumor shows fibrous tissue, woven bone, and supporting vasculature with brown coloration of osteolytic cysts
Pathology finding: Numerous giant cells with multiple osteoclastlike nuclei and giant multinucleated cells dispersed in contact with fibers associated with small vessels
